b: 空ッ (そらッ) - sky, shouted with a sharp cut-off (small ッ)
こぼれ落ちた (こぼれおちた) - spilled down, fell (past of こぼれ落ちる)
二つ+の (ふたつ+の) - two (things) + の (possessive)
星 (ほし) - star
lines.t: Sky! Two stars that spilled down.

b: 光 (ひかり) - light
闇 (やみ) - darkness
水面 (みなも) - water's surface (poetic reading; standard is すいめん)
吸い込まれて+ゆく (すいこまれて+ゆく) - being swallowed (passive te-form of 吸い込む) + ゆく (drifting on)
lines.l: light and darkness of water-surface swallowed-be-going
lines.t: Into the water's surface of light and darkness, they are swallowed.

b: 引き合う (ひきあう) - to pull each other, to attract
重なる (かさなる) - to overlap, to pile up (ように - as if)
波紋 (はもん) - ripple
lines.t: As if drawn together, overlapping ripples.

b: 誇り (ほこり) - pride, honor
道 (みち) - path, road
道を行く (みちをゆく) - to walk the path (行く read ゆく poetically)
者 (もの) - person, those who
太陽 (たいよう) - sun
導き (みちびき) - guidance
lines.l: pride of path [object] go person to, sun of guidance [object]
lines.t: To those who walk the path of pride, grant the sun's guidance.

b: 野望 (やぼう) - ambition
果て (はて) - end, extremity
目指す (めざす) - to aim for, to target
生贄 (いけにえ) - sacrifice
lines.l: ambition of end [object] aim person to, sacrifice [object]
lines.t: To those who aim for the end of ambition, grant sacrifice.

b: 震える+ほど (ふるえる+ほど) - to tremble, so much that (ほど)
心 (こころ) - heart, mind
燃え尽きる+ほど (もえつきる+ほど) - to burn out completely, to the extent that
熱く (あつく) - hotly (adverbial of 熱い)
lines.l: tremble extent heart, burn-out extent hotly
lines.t: A heart that trembles, burning so hot it consumes itself.

b: 放て (はなて) - release, fire (imperative of 放つ)
鼓動 (こどう) - heartbeat
漲る (みなぎる) - to overflow, to fill up
勇気 (ゆうき) - courage
lines.l: that hand from release heartbeat, body overflow courage with
lines.t: Release the heartbeat from those hands, with courage overflowing in your body.

b: 迷い無き (まよいなき) - without hesitation (無き: classical negative)
覚悟 (かくご) - resolve, readiness
喝采 (かっさい) - cheers, applause
血 (ち) - blood
運命 (さだめ) - fate, destiny (usually read うんめい; the song dictates さだめ)
